flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui pages/Report/{index,action/ActionReport,lists/ReportList,hook/useDownloadReport}; ocmsadminapi workflows/reports (no court report). Report by case type and sort by ID: no code.
note: The story asks for a report by court case type (fresh, company, further mention, warrant of arrest) sorted by ID, viewable/downloadable by case type. No report or filter with those categories exists. Report/index.tsx:61-76 only declares four other titles (Court Application Vault, Court Application Submit, Court Summon, Court Rejected) with path "", the resource is commented out, and they are not rendered. A generic download mechanism (useDownloadReport) exists for other reports, so download is only Sebagian. The warrant of arrest entity is only a UI model (Iwarrantofarrest.d.ts) used by notice search. The story status is blank, so the requirement is not given; traced normally. Grep: fresh, company, further mention, warrant of arrest, WOA, case type, sort by ID.
recommendation: Do not claim except the generic download mechanism (Sebagian). The court report by case type and sort by ID is not built.

steps.step: OCMS generates the court report per case type (fresh, company, further mention, warrant of arrest)
steps.detail: No code generates a court report from the mention date. Report/index.tsx:61-76 only declares 4 titles (Court Application Vault, Court Application Submit, Court Summon, Court Rejected) with path ""; their resource is commented out (ActionReport.tsx:33-62); they are not rendered in ReportList.tsx:11-32; there is no court report controller in ocmsadminapi/workflows/reports (only daily, agency mha/ps/toppan, system rip/notification/noticecreated/plusnotification/hst). The four existing titles (Vault, Submit, Summon, Rejected) are not the case types named in the story and are not functional.

steps.step: Report content is sorted by ID
steps.detail: There is no sort-by-ID logic for a court report because the report does not exist. The existing report controllers/services (daily, agency, system) do not touch court case types.

steps.step: Officer views the report by case type in the staff portal
steps.detail: ReportList.tsx:11-32 only imports other report lists (HST, TS, DOS, Letter, SMS, MHA, etc.); SHORTLISTING/COURTDESCAPP/SUMMON/REJECTED exist only in the types and Meta (Freport.d.ts:14-15, Report/index.tsx:61-76), with no page.

steps.step: Officer downloads the report by case type and ID
steps.detail: A generic download mechanism exists: useDownloadReport calls the download/blob endpoint (useDownloadReport.ts:9-30, 76). It serves other reports; there is no court file per case type to download. It is a generic mechanism, not the feature the story names, hence Sebagian.
